theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_tc_cl_dfm_isoperimetric_filling
theorems.statement: (∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : NNReal, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 0 < ρ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsCompact T.support → T.mass < ∞ → T.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity Q ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Q.boundary ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ T - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ (Q = 0 ∨ ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ Q.mass) ∧ Q.mass ≤ c * T.mass ∧ Q.boundary.mass ≤ c * T.boundary.mass ∧ R.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * T.mass ∧ S.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * T.boundary.mass ∧ Q.support ∪ R.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * ρ) T.support ∧ Q.boundary.support ∪ S.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * ρ) T.boundary.support) → ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : ℝ, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Z → IsCompact Z.support → Z.boundary = 0 → Z.mass < ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.boundary = Z ∧ Y.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (2 * c * Z.mass.toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (m + 1)) * Z.mass.toReal) ∧ Y.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * (2 * c * Z.mass.toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (m + 1))) Z.support
